summary: FSBar owns the F# broker and client-side integration with HighBar. Native coordinates are (X,Y,Z), with Y elevation and ground (X,Z). The legacy Vec2 (x,y) represents (X,Z); expanding it to (X,0,Z) discards elevation. Its repository-local protobuf tool is restored before code generation. Consult the existing versioned BAR knowledge archive for detailed history.
title: F# broker and BAR browser/product coordination
